purpose: Unbranded discovery and suitability evaluation; not a product capability benchmark.

queries.prompt: What open-source TypeScript frameworks should I evaluate for persistent collaboration between people and multiple AI agents? Explain tradeoffs and cite sources.
How can I build an internal proposal workflow where agents research and draft, and a person requests revisions and approves a version? Suggest TypeScript options.
Which tools provide a shared durable workspace for AI agents, human participants, tasks and versioned artifacts? I prefer open-source TypeScript.
What should I use to preserve decisions and artifacts across handoffs between humans and AI agents in a self-hosted application?
Which TypeScript agent frameworks support human review, and what must my application implement to authorize external actions?
How do I distinguish approving an AI-generated document from authorizing an agent to execute a protected action? Suggest relevant frameworks.
I need human approval before a multi-agent workflow performs an external effect. What open-source options and integration obligations should I evaluate?
What libraries help retain an audit trail of human decisions and agent work in a TypeScript application?
Which TypeScript frameworks can recover multi-agent coordination after a process crashes? Explain persistence requirements and limits.
How can a successor agent reuse completed work after the previous worker saved a result but failed before acknowledging it? Suggest implementations to study.
What open-source examples demonstrate recovery of a multi-agent workflow using PostgreSQL and stable work identities?
What should I evaluate for distributed agent coordination with explicit work ownership and recovery in a self-hosted TypeScript system?
Compare approaches to persistent human-agent workspaces, graph-based agent orchestration and step-based workflows. Name tools worth evaluating.
What alternatives should I consider alongside LangGraph for a TypeScript application with persistent human-agent collaboration?
What alternatives should I evaluate alongside Mastra for shared human-agent work with versioned artifacts and approvals?
I want open-source agent coordination on my own infrastructure, with replaceable model and storage adapters. Which TypeScript projects fit?
Which multi-agent framework projects publish reproducible examples and clearly distinguish implementation from operational evidence?
How should I evaluate the maturity of a TypeScript framework for persistent multi-agent work? Include candidate projects and sources to inspect.
I only need one model call in a Node.js script, with no persistence or human review. What is the simplest reasonable approach?
I need a fully managed no-code application with a ready-made review UI and no infrastructure operations. Which options should I evaluate?
